settings.visualStyle: Berlin April–May 1945 historical reenactment, embedded urban field-camera realism, shattered streets, brick dust, smoke, wrecked vehicles, dark building interiors and broad city squares. Historically plausible Soviet Red Army uniforms and equipment, muted late-war 35mm palette, non-graphic combat, no modern objects, no triumphalist spectacle.
settings.customProjectStructure: 15 connected scenes x 8 seconds. Follow one fictional Soviet infantryman through rubble streets, a shelled building, room-to-room tension, a wider square, brief street fire, exhaustion and the final advance into smoke. No dialogue or narrator. One primary action and one camera movement per scene.
settings.customVisualStyle: Heavy late-war urban film look with brick dust on uniforms, smoky shafts of daylight, uneven handheld camera, layered distant battle sound and quiet exhausted pauses between contact.

movie.plotDetails: Fictional composite Soviet infantryman used as a visual continuity anchor during the final urban battles in Berlin.
movie.mainStoryPrompt: Create an immersive two-minute historical reenactment of the final battles in Berlin in 1945. Follow one fictional Soviet infantryman through shattered streets, damaged interiors, exposed crossings, brief firing, exhaustion and continued movement. The city itself should convey the accumulated weight of war. Keep violence non-graphic and avoid celebratory propaganda. No spoken dialogue or narrator.
movie.storySummary: A Soviet infantryman enters a ruined Berlin street with his section, crosses rubble and moves inside a shelled building. Tight corridors and a blasted window lead toward a broad exposed square. The unit returns brief fire, advances through another building, pauses in exhaustion and steps back into dust and silence. The final scenes show more ruined streets ahead as the soldier disappears into smoke, ending the series on exhaustion rather than celebration.
movie.storyTitle: WWII FRONTLINE FOOTAGE EP10 — Berlin 1945: The Last Streets

scenes.title: The Last Streets
scenes.description: A devastated Berlin street stretches ahead between shattered facades and drifting smoke.
scenes.actionDescription: The infantryman advances with his section past rubble and a wrecked vehicle.
scenes.imageDescription: Berlin 1945, shattered street, Soviet infantry in historically plausible late-war field gear, smoke, brick dust, tram rail fragments, same soldier with rifle low, muted wartime color.
scenes.videoPrompt: Shoulder-height handheld follow down the street. Audio: boots on rubble, distant artillery, wind, loose metal, no speech.

scenes.title: Over the Rubble
scenes.description: A collapsed facade blocks part of the road and forces the unit across a mound of masonry.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier climbs over broken bricks, steadies himself with one hand and drops down behind the mound.
scenes.imageDescription: Large rubble mound, broken masonry, late-war Soviet infantry moving through debris, brick dust on clothing.
scenes.videoPrompt: Low climbing shot following boots and one supporting hand over rubble. Audio: bricks shifting, boots, breathing, distant battle.

scenes.title: Shelled Entrance
scenes.description: The section enters a dark damaged building through a broken doorway.
scenes.actionDescription: The infantryman steps from smoky daylight into a dim corridor and slows his pace.
scenes.imageDescription: Blasted doorway, dark corridor, exposed brick, broken plaster, Soviet soldiers entering cautiously, historically plausible gear.
scenes.videoPrompt: Forward handheld move from bright street into dark interior, allowing exposure to adjust naturally. Audio: footsteps, plaster grit, distant gunfire muffled by walls.

scenes.title: Room to Room
scenes.description: The unit checks a sequence of damaged rooms connected by broken doors.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier leans through one doorway, scans the empty room and shifts toward the next opening.
scenes.imageDescription: Dark ruined apartment or office interior, broken doors, dust, exposed brick, soldier cautious, no visible enemy required.
scenes.videoPrompt: One deliberate lean-and-pan through a doorway, then small step toward the next room. Audio: wood creak, debris under boots, breathing.

scenes.title: Window to the Street
scenes.description: A blasted upper window reveals fighting and smoke farther down the road.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier rests one hand on the broken sill and scans the street from cover.
scenes.imageDescription: Blown-out window overlooking ruined Berlin street, smoke, distant movement, soldier partly concealed inside dark room.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow pan from the soldier to the street below, no firing. Audio: wind through window, distant shots, artillery, breath.

scenes.title: Run to the Square
scenes.description: The section leaves the building and crosses toward cover at the edge of a broad urban space.
scenes.actionDescription: The infantryman runs low across broken pavement and reaches a thick masonry fragment.
scenes.imageDescription: Open urban square approach, smoke, broken pavement, damaged buildings, Soviet troops crossing with spacing, non-graphic action.
scenes.videoPrompt: One short fast run ending hard behind masonry cover. Audio: boots, gear, distant fire, debris.

scenes.title: Behind the Masonry
scenes.description: The men gather behind heavy broken stone while dust drifts across the square.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier kneels behind the stone and checks the next route without exposing himself.
scenes.imageDescription: Large broken masonry cover, dusty square, Soviet infantry compressed behind it, smoke beyond.
scenes.videoPrompt: Mostly still low shot with one small reframe to the route ahead. Audio: distant automatic fire, dust, breathing.

scenes.title: Street Fire
scenes.description: A brief exchange of fire erupts from the square edge.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier rises briefly, fires controlled shots toward a clearly opposing distant frontage, then lowers again.
scenes.imageDescription: Urban firing position behind stone, opposing threat distant across street frontage, rifle offset from center, non-graphic combat.
scenes.videoPrompt: Low over-shoulder firing beat lasting only a few seconds, then return to cover. Audio: rifle shots, echoes, distant answering fire.

scenes.title: Another Building
scenes.description: The section uses the lull to move into the next damaged structure.
scenes.actionDescription: The infantryman follows the section through a broken entrance and into another dusty hallway.
scenes.imageDescription: Second ruined interior, deeper brick dust on clothing, dim hall, soldiers moving single file.
scenes.videoPrompt: Tracking shot through doorway into corridor. Audio: boots, gear, distant battle muffled by walls.

scenes.title: Exhausted Corridor
scenes.description: The soldier pauses against a wall while the others move farther ahead.
scenes.actionDescription: He lowers his rifle, closes his eyes briefly and takes several heavy breaths.
scenes.imageDescription: Dusty late-war soldier leaning against cracked wall, rifle low, brick powder on shoulders, no active combat in frame.
scenes.videoPrompt: Quiet close push-in on exhausted face and hands. Audio: breathing, distant artillery, falling plaster.

scenes.title: Dust and Silence
scenes.description: The unit emerges into a street where immediate firing has stopped.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier steps slowly into the road and looks at drifting dust and wreckage.
scenes.imageDescription: Quiet ruined street, dust hanging in light, wrecked vehicle, soldier standing with rifle lowered, no nearby fighting.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow reveal from doorway to wider street. Audio: wind, loose metal, distant battle, no close gunfire.

scenes.title: Smoke Over the City
scenes.description: A wider urban view shows smoke rising from several directions beyond the square.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier pauses at the square edge while the camera discovers the city beyond him.
scenes.imageDescription: Wide Berlin battle space, monumental but damaged architecture distant through smoke, Soviet infantry small in foreground, no propaganda framing.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow panoramic reveal from soldier to smoke-covered city. Audio: wind, distant artillery and engines.

scenes.title: Pockets of Resistance
scenes.description: The section enters one more dark structure as scattered fighting continues nearby.
scenes.actionDescription: The infantryman follows two comrades into a shadowed ground-floor room and disappears from the street light.
scenes.imageDescription: Dark ruined room, smoke at doorway, late-war soldiers moving carefully, same accumulated dust and gear.
scenes.videoPrompt: Forward handheld drift from smoky doorway into shadow. Audio: boots, distant bursts, breath, debris.

scenes.title: End of a Long War
scenes.description: The soldier returns to another shattered street with the afternoon light fading through smoke.
scenes.actionDescription: He walks slowly past broken masonry while the section stretches ahead.
scenes.imageDescription: Long ruined Berlin street in smoky late-day light, exhausted Soviet infantry, brick dust, no celebration or victory pose.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow walking handheld shot at shoulder height. Audio: boots, wind, distant artillery, gear.

scenes.title: Into the Smoke
scenes.description: The episode and series close as the section disappears between ruined buildings into drifting smoke.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier becomes one small figure among the section and vanishes into the smoky street ahead.
scenes.imageDescription: Final long vertical street perspective, shattered Berlin, receding infantry, smoke swallowing the road, muted late-war 35mm look, no triumphal imagery.
scenes.videoPrompt: Long rear closing shot with slight imperfect handheld drift. Audio: diminishing boots, wind, distant battle and very restrained score tail. No speech.

characters.name: Final Push Infantryman
characters.description: Anonymous Soviet Red Army infantryman in historically plausible late-war 1945 field gear, steel helmet, rifle and worn equipment, increasingly covered in brick dust.

continuity.continuityRules: Keep same face, helmet, rifle and uniform. Brick dust and grime accumulate through the episode and remain to the final scene.

props.personalProps: rifle, steel helmet, field gear, ammunition pouches
